title: Costco Wholesale, FY2025 vs FY2024

attempts.text: Costco Wholesale Corporation (CY) reported a significant increase in revenue, up by 8.2% compared to the previous year. This growth is attributed to an increase in operating cash flow and capital expenditure, which have also increased by up to 17.6% and 16.7%, respectively. The largest movers in FY2025 were operating cash flow, capital expenditure, and operating income, with operating cash flow increasing by up to 17.6% and capital expenditure increasing by up to 16.7%. These positive changes indicate a strong financial performance and a favorable outlook for the company.

final_text: Costco revenue was $275.2bn in FY2025, up 8.2% from $254.5bn in FY2024. Operating margin was 3.77% (up 0.12 pp), with SG&A at 9.07% of revenue. The largest movements were: Operating cash flow increased by $2.00bn; Capital expenditure increased by $0.79bn; Operating income increased by $1.10bn.
